plotEn:
The Good Lawyer (French: Un bon avocat) is a 2026 French thriller drama film directed by Tristan Séguéla, co-written with Marcia Romano, Simon Jacquet, and Stéphane Sebag. It stars Laurent Lafitte, Mélanie Laurent and Carole Bouquet.
The film had its world premiere out of competition of the 83rd Venice International Film Festival on 11 September 2026. It was released worldwide by Netflix on 9 November 2026.
